Transaction isolation is the degree to which the operations of one transaction are separated from those of other concurrent transactions. It ensures that concurrent transactions do not interfere with each other, maintaining data consistency. - **Serializable:** The strictest level; transactions are executed as if they were serial (one after another), preventing all anomalies.
